title: ALU Control Decoder
constraints: Output encoding matches the ALU problem: ADD 0, SUB 1, AND 2, OR 3, XOR 4, SLL 6, SRL 7, SRA 8, SLT 9, SLTU 10.
R-type `funct3 = 000` uses `funct7_5` to pick SUB over ADD. I-type `000` is always ADD (there is no SUBI).
For shifts right (`funct3 = 101`), `funct7_5 = 1` selects SRA in both R- and I-type. Purely combinational.
hints: A nested `case`: first on `alu_op`, then on `funct3`.
Only two funct3 values care about `funct7_5`: 000 (R-type only) and 101.
Give every branch an assignment. A default at the top of the block avoids latches.
